claims.claim: A Rubin GPU's shipping HBM4 bandwidth is 19.2 TB/s, about 9.375 Gbps per pin, down from a 22 TB/s target at about 10.75 Gbps per pin.

claims.supporting_quote: But with these revised shipping specifications, a single Rubin GPU will now provide 19.2TB/second of bandwidth, for a data rate of about 9.375Gbps/pin, a net loss of 1.375Gbps, or roughly 11%.

claims.claim: NVL72 scale-out networking bandwidth was revised from 28.8 TB/s to 32.4 TB/s bidirectional, while scale-up fell from 260 TB/s to 216 TB/s.
claims.episode_span: scale-up bandwidth is 216 TB/s, down from 260 TB/s, while scale-out networking is 32.4 TB/s bidirectional, up from 28.8 TB/s.
claims.source_title: NVIDIA Updates Rubin GPU Specs as First Production Hardware Arrives
claims.supporting_quote: So whereas NVL72 was originally slated to offer 28.8TB/second of networking bandwidth, that has been dialed up to 32.4TB/second (bidirectional).
